number.title: ParticipantId
number.authority: reference only; exactly one own profile resolved from SharePoint currentuser

number_2.title: MembershipId
number_2.meaning: Explicit immutable episode; never select a newer episode on retry

text.title: IntentId
text.type: UUID, case-insensitive canonical lower-case operation key
text.meaning: Generate once for each explicit Leave; retain UUID and all target IDs for transport retries

sharedGuard.format: OperationKey + colon + server-generated attempt UUID; maximum 255 chars
sharedGuard.crossWriter: Same opaque operation:attempt string/empty-field CAS mutex as #11. Never inspect/parse/clear another token; all writers of capacity/state/membership must honor the guard. Only WriteOwner overlaps other group writers.
sharedGuard.claim: Read exact group, require blank owner; MERGE WriteOwner only with exact numeric quoted ETag and retries none; reread same ID/state/capacity/source/setup + exact own token.
sharedGuard.release: Only after Complete/result receipt readback; fresh group read, CAS clear only the exact saved old token using current exact ETag. Reread to prove old token absent. A different token is preserved.
sharedGuard.recovery: Incomplete/uncertain existing receipt is read-only OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; no lease, TTL, automatic takeover, sealing platform, delete or speculative unlock. Completed receipt retry may release only its old token, with no member/receipt rewrites.

authority.initial: Unique own profile from currentuser; own MembershipId/GroupId/ParticipantId exact match, typed group/member/request snapshots.
authority.commit: Group.SetupComplete=true; Group.SourceRequestId -> Accepted+OperationComplete Personal request. Extract request ID from canonical MembershipKey request:{requestId}:participant:{actorId}; fresh Accepted+OperationComplete. Initial personal episode must reference group source and include actor as a party. Joined episode must reference Group request with TargetGroupId matching group, SenderParticipantId matching actor, null recipient.
authority.fresh: Repeat exact group/member and both source/request commitment checks under WriteOwner; exactly one physical Active episode for actor, and its ID matches requested episode. A raw Active provisional episode never authorizes Leave.
authority.availability: Operational committed MembershipStatus=Active authorizes explicit Leave independently of ParticipationStatus/OpenToConnections. Paused/Inactive/openness changes preserve memberships. No Discovery Require_available_actor, profile-content/catalogue normalization or compatibility call. New-join requester and focus-sharer eligibility remain separate consumer rules.

reads.members: All physical episodes for group, top2001 bound2000, typed rows, no partial page; count every Active including provisional/paused rows.
reads.freshCounts: Under guard before and after Leave; own Active count must go 1->0 and total Active decrease exactly one; free slots=max(0,Capacity-activeCount). Replays return saved historical counts; UI must refresh for current state.

sequence: Create unique immutable receipt with attempt UUID
Own Active membership exact ETag -> MembershipStatus Left + LeftAt UTC seconds
Complete receipt with exact ETag + immutable ResultJson, DomainEffects true, Stage Complete
Release only matching old group token exact ETag
writes.history: Preserve JoinedAt, MembershipKey, parties, other episodes, Closed/Ended and all unrelated properties; no automatic discovery-state repair.
writes.settledReadback: Succeeded/Failed/TimedOut only; Skipped cannot reconcile a write; positive ReceiptReady and ReleaseProved guards permit safe continuation across failed native containers.

outputs.success: Boolean; true only LEFT after Complete receipt and old token absence proved
outputs.resultcode: Text: LEFT | ALREADY_LEFT | UNAUTHORIZED | NOT_MEMBER | PROVISIONAL_MEMBERSHIP | MEMBERSHIP_INTEGRITY | MEMBERSHIP_CHANGED | GROUP_INTEGRITY | INTENT_CONFLICT | RECEIPT_INTEGRITY | GROUP_BUSY | GROUP_BUSY_OR_UNKNOWN | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | RELEASE_PENDING | INCOMPLETE_READ | INVALID_INPUT | READ_OR_DATA_FAILED
outputs.resultjson: Text JSON object below only on success; otherwise {}
outputs.replay: Boolean; saved completed receipt used and success proved
outputs.writeattempted: Boolean; any receipt/guard/membership write attempted, not just domain effect
outputs.outcomeunknown: Boolean; write attempted without full confirmed success, conservatively includes a saved incomplete receipt/failed release

replay: Same intent+same frozen payload returns saved historical result without reapplying leave. Same intent changed targets -> INTENT_CONFLICT. Different intent for already Left episode -> ALREADY_LEFT/false, zero writes; refresh history. Rejoined/new episode is never substituted for old MembershipId.
